overview: Honey Do's is a home-service booking and management app with a branded customer site and a professional admin workspace covering requests, quotes, deposits, payments, scheduling and jobs.
features: Customers request a service and track their job by reference code
Automatic quote pricing with line items, discounts, tax, 10% deposit and remaining balance
Customer payment page with deposit submission and payment methods
Admin payment verification that confirms the booking and books the calendar
Admin dashboard, requests, calendar, customers, quotes, jobs, payments, messages, notifications and settings
Permanent customer profiles with full request, quote, job and payment history
Alerts for new requests, messages, quote approvals, deposits and payments
